title: Introduce RAG inline e2e journey kit with smoke probes and observability
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Teams building RAG-powered features need a lightweight, repeatable end-to-end (E2E) journey kit that covers authoring -> indexing -> runtime tool-calling -> graceful degradation and includes production-like observability probes. This PR adds a compact quickstart that wires together a tiny local indexer, a sandboxed tool-caller stub, and an inline smoke-test runner that asserts structured outputs and emits telemetry probes compatible with the Redwood Console ingestion format.

What this change includes: 1) quickstarts/rag-e2e-journey/ - a minimal journey that demonstrates an authoring loop, an incremental indexer, and a request replay runner for smoke checks; 2) an observability adapter shim (quickstarts/rag-e2e-journey/telemetry/adapters/redwood-probe.ts) that emits token/latency/cost metrics and attaches stable trace ids to each session; 3) a small set of authored scenario files (scenarios/*.jsonl) and a typesafe contract that the tool-caller must satisfy (tool-contracts/README.md); 4) CI smoke job integration (ci/smoke-rag-journey.yml) that runs the inline runner in container and checks for structured output JSON schema conformance.

Design notes: - The runner is intentionally synchronous and deterministic: it seeds the index with a small corpus, runs a fixed series of prompts, and validates three invariants: (a) every tool call includes a valid contract hash, (b) model responses conform to the declared schema, and (c) tail latency remains under an envelope for the simulated local runtime. - Observability probes follow the Console's minimal ingestion shape (session_id, step, duration_ms, tokens_out, tokens_in, fallback_triggered) to make the quickstart plug-and-play with customers' Console dashboards. - The quickstart favors clarity over performance; it demonstrates patterns for productionizing (incremental indexing hooks, telemetry enrichment, smoke gating) but does not attempt heavy batching or KV optimizations.

Checklist: - [x] Add quickstart directory and README with step-by-step run instructions and debugging tips. - [x] Provide typesafe tool-contract examples and contract linter config. - [x] Add CI smoke job and sample GH Actions workflow. - [x] Add minimal telemetry adapter and example Grafana dashboard JSON (telemetry/dashboard.json). - [x] Add unit and snapshot tests for the runner.

How to run locally (summary): 1) cd quickstarts/rag-e2e-journey && pnpm install 2) pnpm seed && pnpm run smoke -- --runner=local 3) watch logs in telemetry/mock-ingest.log or point the adapter to a local Console dev endpoint.

Risks and mitigation: - Telemetry shape changes: adapter code includes a compatibility shim and feature flag in telemetry/config.ts. - Flaky CI: smoke job is isolated to a self-hosted runner matrix and marked non-blocking for main branch until 2 successful green runs.

Related: follows patterns from ENG-4821 (RAG quality gates) and references docs UX work in PM-193. The README contains a migration note on how to adopt the kit for Dedicated/Private deployments.
